# R packages the R job needs, one per line (blank lines and # comments ignored).
# Single-sourced here because .github/workflows/ci.yml both installs from this
# file and keys its package cache on its hash -- editing the list invalidates
# the cache automatically.
#
# THIS IS NOT renv.lock, ON PURPOSE. This repo does have a renv.lock, and
# .Rprofile sources renv/activate.R, but the CI job disables the autoloader
# (RENV_CONFIG_AUTOLOADER_ENABLED=FALSE) and installs from this list instead.
# Reason: the lockfile pins the full interactive/Shiny/modelling environment --
# shinytest2, chromote, tidymodels, the lot -- and the R job runs four test
# scripts that need a small fraction of it. Restoring the lockfile would be the
# slowest step in CI by a wide margin to gain nothing the tests check.
# (MLB's ci.yml documents the other half of this trade-off: a lockfile restore
# must pin a DATED P3M snapshot rather than `latest`, and RENV_CONFIG_REPOS_
# OVERRIDE beats the lockfile's own repo entry. Read it before switching.)
#
# Derived from the library() calls reachable from the four files in
# .github/scripts/run-tests.R's RUN list, including everything they source():
#   here        config.R, which hard-stops without it. Every test sources
#               config.R, so missing this failed all four at once on the
#               job's first run -- it was installed locally and invisible.
#   tidyverse   prediction_accuracy_logger, player_metrics, and the dplyr /
#               stringr / tidyr / tibble calls in the tests themselves
#   wehoop      player_metrics.R  (sourced by test_pure_functions.R)
#   slider      player_metrics.R
#   duckdb      logging_utils.R   (sourced by all four, transitively)
#   DBI         the duckdb call sites
#   httr2       test_phase4_engine.R, market_odds_engine.R
#   httr        market_odds_engine.R
#   jsonlite    market_odds_engine.R
#   ranger      market_odds_engine.R
#
# bcrypt, RSQLite and sys were removed with the control panel login (now in
# retired/control_panel/); nothing else in the repo uses them.
here
tidyverse
wehoop
slider
duckdb
DBI
httr2
httr
jsonlite
ranger
